info.name: I guerrieri della notte
info.plot: Nel Bronx, durante un raduno di tutte le gang di New York, un carismatico leader viene ucciso: la colpa ricade sui Warriors, gang poco nota di Coney Island. Comincia la caccia. Senza il loro capo, ucciso per ritorsione, gli otto Warriors disarmati devono tornare a casa attraversando la metropoli, braccati dalle altre vendicative gang e dalla polizia.

translations.overview: Prominent gang leader Cyrus calls a meeting of New York's gangs to set aside their turf wars and take over the city. At the meeting, a rival leader kills Cyrus, but a Coney Island gang called the Warriors is wrongly blamed for Cyrus' death. Before you know it, the cops and every gangbanger in town is hot on the Warriors' trail.
translations.tagline: These are the armies of the night. They are 100,000 strong. They outnumber the cops five to one. They could run New York City. Tonight they're all out to get the Warriors.
